title: Rio Tinto - proposed acquisition of a 50% interest in the Hope Downs Iron Ore Project.

body_sections.Summary: Rio Tinto Ltd - proposed acquisition of a 50% interest in the Hope Downs Iron Ore Project.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the global, seaborne and domestic supply of iron ore, and the supply of transport services for iron ore in the Pilbara region.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any of the relevant markets and decided to not oppose the proposed acquisition. For detailed reasons for the ACCC's view, please refer to the Public Competition Assessment which has been published.
